core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nezha is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Excursion, outing, promenade”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nezha corresponds to the Arabic form نُزْهَة (Arabic root ن ز ه (n-z-h); نُزْهَة (Nuzha)). Its core sense is nezha; a female given name. Nezha is Arabic نُزْهَة (Nuzha) 'excursion, outing, promenade', from the root ن ز ه (n-z-h). The source gloss 'Gleaming, Radiant' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as nazha.

persian.name: نزهه

arabic.name: نُزْهَة
arabic.long_meaning: Nezha (نُزْهَة) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي نُزْهَة (اسْم عَلَم مُؤَنَّث). يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.
